en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al-Fazl Bin ShAzaan, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Mansour Bin Hazim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘
The seeking of Forgiveness in Al-Witr (Salāt) is seventy times’.
en.sarwar: 33. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur ibn Hazim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
in al-Witr, ask forgiveness from Allah seventy times.” (Ahadith 20-34 are best explained in the form of fatwa.)
